title: AI – Driven Virtual Instructor for 3D Virtual Electronics Lab
summary: An Ethiopian project plans a nine-month virtual-lab pilot with AI feedback and Amharic support. Access and skill gains remain prospective.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: An Ethiopian project plans a nine-month virtual-lab pilot with AI feedback and Amharic support. Access and skill gains remain prospective.
purpose: Make practical electronics learning accessible without full physical laboratories.
system: AI virtual instructor for a 3D electronics laboratory

ratings.reason: Underserved STEM students are intended to gain laboratory access and skills.
Training institutions are intended to provide laboratories at lower cost; no realized saving is reported.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use case -5: AI – Driven Virtual Instructor for 3D Virtual Electronics Lab

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Virtual laboratory software and localized instructional content

headline: An AI instructor for a virtual electronics laboratory
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
